title: The Pólya–Vinogradov inequality with log log q: Lean 4 formalization and verification code
description:
Lean 4 formalization of the paper The Pólya–Vinogradov inequality with log log q by Deep Bhattacharjee and Ushashi Bhattacharya, with the LaTeX source, the paper as a PDF, and four programs (Python, Julia, C, C++) that check its numerical steps.

The paper proves that every primitive Dirichlet character modulo q ≥ 3 has character sums of size at most C√q log log q, the bound Montgomery and Vaughan proved under the generalised Riemann hypothesis, and that |L'/L(1, χ)| ≤ C log log q and −C log q log log q ≤ γ_q ≤ C log q for the Euler–Kronecker constants of the cyclotomic fields Q(ζ_q), q prime. The input is the zero-free half-plane Re s > 7/8 for Dirichlet L-functions proved and formalised by OpenAI (https://github.com/openai/math, 30 September 2026), whose Lean sources are compiled here unchanged. The Lean proofs use only the axioms propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.
